topic: Retrieving impersonated user data for analytics
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on technical methods for accessing specific user data within the application. Initially, [p1] struggled to retrieve the correct user context when viewing analytics data, as the standard `userService.currentUser` pipe only provided the logged-in user. [me] clarified that the necessary field is `userData.impersonatedUser`, which provides access to the intended impersonation context.

Later in the session, there was a discussion about coding standards and best practices, including using Angular components (e.g., `buildMenu`, `buildMenuItem`) and avoiding deep copying issues when handling objects.
decisions: Use `userData.impersonatedUser` to access data for an impersonated user context.
